steps.name: Returning to the Magic Academy
steps.objective: Follow [Shiina]'s directions in 「Magic Academy Lobby」 and enter the 「Headmaster's Office」. Then turn in the quest to [Zephyros].

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Adventurer! Welcome!
(The moment Shiina spots %s, she rushes over, beaming, and throws her arms around them.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I've missed you so much!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You haven't changed, Shiina. It's good to see you.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: How have you been? I've heard the rumors, but I'd love to hear it from you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A lot has happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Shiina about everything that happened since we last met.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Wow...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: You've been through so much. And you managed to resolve it all! You're amazing, Adventurer.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: I've been wanting to see you again, so I'm really glad you're here. You've seen my sister so many times...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Somehow, I've ended up owing Dayna quite a lot.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Oh, right!

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Actually, Chairman Zephyros asked me to send you a message on his behalf.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Since you came so quickly, it must have reached you. I'd never sent wind magic so far before, so I was a little worried.
(Shiina looks delighted.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see. Where are Chloris and Zephyros?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: They're both in the principal's office. Whatever they're discussing, it's taking a while.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: The principal's office is over there. I'll show you the way.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Shiina. It's right there. But what's all that noise?
(The door shakes as a heated conversation rages inside the principal's office. Shiina looks embarrassed, then sighs.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Sigh... My sisters are here.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your sisters? Oh...

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: They're both wonderful, but once they start talking to each other...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's how siblings are, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Is it?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Now that you're here, I wish they'd stop...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Have you got any ideas?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Just a moment, please.
(With a determined look, Shiina opens the office door a crack and tries her own approach.)

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: If you two don't behave, I'm going to Great-Aunt!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your great-aunt?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes. She's a wonderful person. Oh, you can go in now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Shiina. Would you like to come in too?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: No, thank you. Please tell my sisters I'll wait here. I don't really want to see them right now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I will, Shiina. See you later.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: All right! Enjoy your talk.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Did that actually work? Hmm...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's me, %s. May I come in?

lines.speaker: 클로리스의 목소리
lines.text: Yes, %s. Come in.
(It is the adventurer's first visit to the principal's office since the school festival. Zephyros notices them first and offers a greeting.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Welcome.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: %s, welcome. We've been waiting for you. Come to think of it, this is your first time in the principal's office, isn't it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No, I came here during the school festival to fight you after you fused with the Windy Seed...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Aaaah! Please forget that!

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And while you're at it, could you forget the winged grandfather clock too? Most of the students think they were seeing things. So you're the only one who really saw it, %s...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Right? If only %s hadn't seen it either...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Chloris... You're not thinking of doing something to me, are you?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, of course not...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, it's written all over your face.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: I still see myself looking like that every night. It's killing me.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It'll get easier with time. But those two don't look very happy...
(Perhaps because of Shiina's words just now, Dayna and Kaina both look stricken.)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Kaina, Shiina said she'd go to Great-Aunt...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: She was probably just saying that... How would she even know where Great-Aunt is...?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Right...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: She did say she'd get in touch. If Shiina were to tell her something like that...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...I don't even want to imagine it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who is their great-aunt? Why are they both so frightened of her?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Shiina told me she's the only older relative they have left whom they can rely on.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: She lives far away and is very busy, so even as children, they didn't see her often.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm, I see. Anyway, are you two all right now?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Oh, %s... You're here?
(Dayna collects herself and greets the adventurer.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You've arrived.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry about last time.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I was too preoccupied to apologize properly then.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We called you all that way, then put you in an awkward position with our family problems. I'm sorry. It wasn't my sister's fault. It was entirely mine...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm sorry, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right. Please don't worry about it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I hadn't expected a visit from Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I have something important to discuss.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Another vision...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Not this time.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If Your Majesty has come to tell us in person, it must be serious...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So you both have something important to tell me. Hmm...

steps.name: An Important Conversation
steps.objective: Use the Talk menu to hear <Events from 10 Years Ago> from [Kaina] and <The Reason for Focusing on the Magic Bureau> from [Zephyros]. Then turn in the quest to [Chloris] in the 「Headmaster's Office」.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That's right.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You may hear either the chairman or me first. Whichever you prefer.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: As Her Majesty says, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (...Whose story should I hear first?)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Allow me to thank you once again. Thank you for resolving the incidents involving the witches on Aie Island and in Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, please, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Despite your efforts, %s, this isn't over. Aaron... I've learned what Aaron is after.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said before that he was searching for witches...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Long ago, a war for supremacy swept through Freios. Many powers rose, fell, and vanished.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: When Silvaria, then a kingdom, emerged victorious, its ruler, Queen Shiina, became our first empress.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You know this much already, don't you, %s?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Not in detail, but I know the broad strokes.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then let me continue.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Humans have long hunted down those they considered a threat. Ferocious animals, beasts from the Demon Realm, demons, and witches alike.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The council of that era chose to focus on witches and began rounding them up. Some of those witches had truly done terrible things... and some had not.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: There were witches who didn't do anything wrong?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes. Some simply lived in hiding and harmed no one.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And some of those arrested as witches were ordinary humans.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They belonged to factions that opposed the nobles who controlled the council. It became all too easy to brand their opponents as witches, or accuse them of worshipping witches...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: They were all killed, weren't they...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: After that, witches rarely showed themselves. Any witch who did faced death at someone's hands.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Now the council has begun seeking witches again, using the same name as before. A...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Witch hunt...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But they can't simply intend to capture and kill them...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: They want something from the witches. Just as witches kill one another and take their power.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Then what about Barbatos?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: He showed up again, taunted me about what happened ten years ago, and toyed with me. I also found evidence that he'd been in contact with a witch, just like back then.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It was probably a coincidence that Barbatos encountered us that day.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: A coincidence...? Kaina, don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Yes. You're right.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Barbatos never appeared in my visions.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, I want to tell %s what happened to us ten years ago. Is that all right?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It's all right. We can trust %s with this.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty... Dayna...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's a rather long story.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Fifteen years ago, when Shiina was two, our mother died of a chronic illness.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The council's nobles seized the opportunity. Insisting that the position of empress consort could not remain vacant for the sake of national stability, they put forward daughters from their own houses.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: They called them recommendations, but they were forcing him to marry the council's choice, have a son, and make him heir.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Unlike previous emperors, our father had snuck out as a prince and courted someone in secret. Then he brought our mother home and declared, almost as a challenge, that he was going to marry her.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That sounds like Father...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Our mother was the only daughter of an impoverished noble house. The council's nobles, with all their wealth, prestige, and power, looked down on her family.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: And they looked down on us as her daughters, too.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Even though we were every bit as much members of the imperial family...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Father refused the council's proposal, saying it would betray both our mother and us.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Rather than marrying again for a son who might never be born, he encouraged the daughters already at his side to dream of a better future.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then, ten years ago... he was murdered. By Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That day, a noble led a band of mercenaries in an attack on the imperial palace. He declared that someone unworthy must never take the throne...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: My foresight held the mercenaries at bay, and the Scar of the Red Moon knights wiped them out. Though there were rather few of them for a rebellion...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Father knew about my ability, but kept it secret. He used my visions only to secure a future in which the rebels were defeated.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Among the futures I saw was his death... He told me never to tell Dayna. With our youngest sister to care for as well, he feared it would unsettle her...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Barbatos appeared and tried to take Shiina. A witch had appeared before him, saying that Shiina had to be taken to the black place.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (The black place?)

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We rescued Shiina with the help of Argent and the other Moon's Scar knights...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Anyway, the witch left as though nothing had happened, saying she'd find another way. We lost consciousness and, for a short time, couldn't remember what had happened...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That witch's name was...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shiina told me. Daphne.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Yes. Daphne...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The witch you encountered in the cathedral, correct?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Like that witch, Barbatos tried to take Shiina away, saying he needed her as a sacrifice.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: First a witch, then a demon... Father tried to protect Shiina from Barbatos. But apart from his title, he was an ordinary human.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: We saved our little sister, but we couldn't save Father. We were weak and foolish... He told us it was all right, but...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna, don't blame yourself...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: After Father fell, Barbatos seemed to change his mind and put Shiina down.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Then... he left, saying we would meet again someday.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: It felt as though Barbatos sensed something then. As if someone he needed to avoid was nearby...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: ...I wish Kaina had seen something at the time, but she hadn't...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Very few of the council's nobles know that Barbatos appeared. The council insisted we keep it that way... Ah... I'd rather not remember this...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I understand why you did it, Kaina. But I don't know if it really was the best choice...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Shall we leave it there?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That is what happened to us ten years ago.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Daphne and Barbatos both wanted Shiina. And what did Daphne mean by finding another way?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe and I will always be grateful to you. For what you did at the school festival, and now in Crystal Moon Forest...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Thank you so much, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Please, I didn't do that much...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And I'm sorry. It feels as though I'm dragging you into this... You already know this, but the Empire's shadows run deep and wide.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shadows...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If I'd never found out, I might have sinned in ignorance. But anyone who knew would have made the same choice I did.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father was a mage, though he preferred to be called a magic researcher.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: He originally intended to spend his life at the Sage's Tower, but he left and continued his research independently.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Magic Bureau had a poor reputation among mages then. It practically monopolized new talent, and its ties to the council made it a willing servant of power.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Father hated taking jobs from the Bureau, but we had little money, so he had no choice but to keep doing it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: It was about ten years ago... a few days before the late emperor died. We received word that Father had touched a magical device without permission in the Bureau's warehouse, triggering a surge of magic that killed him...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Someone of Father's skill would never make a mistake like that... Sigh...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos and I had no family left but each other. When we were lost in despair, we received a great deal of help.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We attended a boarding school in the capital, caught a mage's eye, and even got positions at the Magic Bureau.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: For novice mages, it was the opportunity everyone dreamed of.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: We could do all that because we knew nothing. Once we learned the truth, we were powerless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What on earth happened...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: My father's death was an accident. But it was an accident that need never have happened. The Magic Bureau's shadows caused it...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Father only needed some materials from the warehouse. He didn't know the magic golem sleeping there would awaken...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A magic golem... Don't tell me...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos and I found a bloodstained scrap of Father's cloak caught on the golem in that warehouse...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Notos decided he couldn't stay at the Bureau and went to protest. Meanwhile, I looked for records about the golem.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But they threatened me into silence.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: If we brothers dug any deeper, they would kill everyone around us. Chloe included.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I had to decide then and there. I chose to become their hostage.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: When Notos returned, I picked a fight with him over ridiculous things. Father's death was only an accident, I said. Why should we leave over that...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That was how I drove Notos out of the Magic Bureau. Chloe was next... I disappeared from her life without a word. But I still had to make certain of one thing.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: That she couldn't remain at the Bureau either...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Only after everyone had left did I finally commit to my plan. I would approach the Bureau's shadows. So I spent five years as its dog.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And I did uncover some of it. The darkness I learned about by turning my back on everyone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...You've been through so much.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Mmm...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Chloe, I'm all right. Don't look at me like that.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: But... Oh, how are you going to tell Notos?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I'll handle that myself. Thank you for worrying.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Are things all right between those two now...?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s, listen carefully. We're running out of time. And we'll have even more to do.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You remember where you stopped Degos a few years ago?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Of course. The garden...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The garden nearly became a gateway to the Demon Realm, but you stopped it. Since then, we've discovered several other places that could become gateways too.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Among those I learned of were places you've visited, such as Rosengarten and Vanitas.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Zephyros, you know about those places too? How much does the Magic Bureau know?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I only read the information they compiled. I don't know how they obtained it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: In any case, those gateways have kept appearing and disappearing, and it's caused a serious problem.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The magical whirlwinds between western and eastern Freios, including those in the Void Sea, have begun to settle. Their magic is weakening.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Freios is currently suspended in the sky above the other continents.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait... That means... If the flow of magic surrounding the continent weakens, Freios will...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Exactly what you're imagining. Fall.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The Freios continent broke into pieces and rose into the sky. The moment that magic disappears, those pieces will fall into the seas and onto the other continents of this world.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Good heavens...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Powerful mages could sense this happening. The Magic Bureau's leadership must have felt it especially keenly, but they did nothing.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Instead, they devoted themselves to other matters.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They experimented on human souls and emotions in all sorts of ways to operate an ancient magic golem.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They even created an ancient Creed beastfolk capable of controlling such golems freely. I don't know everything that happened in that laboratory...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But that beastfolk killed a mage and escaped, taking the ancient golem with them. The golem that killed my father...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (No Name and Licaria?)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The council is behind all of it. They stay silent about the gateways, yet pursue this so eagerly.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: And I think others besides the council are involved. A witch and a demon helped the beastfolk get out.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Complicated, isn't it? I'm afraid it can't be helped. That's all I've been able to confirm. I need more information...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: But Her Majesty and Dayna have offered their help, so we should manage.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then what will happen to you, Zephyros? If you know the Bureau's secrets, surely...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: They probably know everything I've done. If they're leaving me alone, I must still be useful to them. Though I don't yet know how.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: The people at the Magic Bureau... They've already abandoned their humanity...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Thank you. That must have been hard to talk about...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: No... Thank you for listening.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What does this demon Barbatos, whom Your Majesty mentioned, want?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Barbatos wants to become the master of this world. A god.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: A god? But he's a demon!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Well, you see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I briefly tell Chloris about meeting Barbatos at the Sanctuary.)
(Listening to %s, Kaina murmurs under her breath.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: That explains it... I've never had a clear vision involving Barbatos...

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Kaina?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Just talking to myself. Never mind.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, there's something I forgot to mention. About the council...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm telling you because I trust you. Please keep this between us.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Argent and the knights have detained one of the council's nobles. They found evidence that he met with a demon.

steps.name: Hello and Goodbye
steps.objective: Talk to [Chloris] in the 「Headmaster's Office」, then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Good heavens...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: I had no idea...
(As everyone struggles to take in these revelations, the grandfather clock in the school lobby chimes the hour.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Oh, is it that late already...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh my, so it is.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: By the way, Kaina. Is it all right for you to be away this long?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I left a doll that looks like me and a note saying, "Taking the day off for personal reasons."

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty...?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Ahem...
(Kaina smiles brightly, as though nothing were amiss.)

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'm joking. I made the proper arrangements before leaving.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: That wasn't funny, Kaina. Nobody seems to believe you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Dayna.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: It's been a while. Let's have a meal together.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: Now? I've got so much that needs doing right away...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Shiina's been wishing for it.

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right. If it's what Shiina wants...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Thank you, Dayna. Oh, %s...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Your Majesty? Was there something you wanted to tell me...?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Oh, no. I'll contact you later.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. I'll wait to hear from you.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: I'll contact you as well when the time comes, Zephyros.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Yes, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: The council and the Bureau's leadership will already know your intentions and everything you've done.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: If danger approaches, I'll warn you first. I've also prepared somewhere for you to stay in Luria.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: You are most gracious, Your Majesty.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Well... Thank you, Zephyros. You've helped me make up my mind.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: We'll take our leave now. Come along, Dayna.

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: You're outside, aren't you, Shiina?

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Yes, Kaina! I'm hungry. How long has it been since we all ate together like this?

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Goodness. How long has it been?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: I'm sorry...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: No apologizing out of nowhere. All right, Dayna?

lines.speaker: 데이나
lines.text: All right...

lines.speaker: 카이나
lines.text: Good. Let's go.

lines.speaker: 시이나
lines.text: Principal, Chairman, I'll be back after eating with my sisters. May I have permission to go out?

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Of course.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Enjoy yourselves.
(With the three sisters gone, the bustling principal's office falls quiet.)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What a hectic day...

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Indeed...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: What are you going to do now?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Meet Notos and talk to him. ...I don't expect him to understand right away, but still...

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Notos will understand everything.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Thank you...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Those two seem to be back to normal... What should I do now...?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (But something feels strange. As though something is about to hap...)
(Just then, the air changes. A little white cloud appears before the adventurer and smiles.)
(A familiar voice comes from within it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Arche? Then is this Aerura?)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (%s, it's me, Arche. I sent Aerura, so you should be able to hear me now, right?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What's wrong?)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (I think you need to come to Pneuma. We've found a door. A path to ▒▒▒▒.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Arche, I couldn't hear the name of the place.)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (Oh... Not yet, then. It seems you still aren't permitted to hear the name.)

lines.speaker: 아르케의 목소리
lines.text: (...Say goodbye to the people you're with, and Aerura will bring you to Pneuma, %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Really?)
(Watching %s murmur into thin air, Zephyros and Chloris nod as if they understand.)

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: %s... You're talking to a spirit.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: It's a cloud. How cute.
(Aerura smiles at Chloris's words, swaying the musical note shape above its head.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, you were watching. Huh? You can both see Aerura?

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Aerura... So that's its name.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: Yes, I can see it.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: What was it saying to keep you talking so long?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: There's somewhere I'm being asked to visit.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: (If a spirit is asking for a visit, it must be serious...)

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: You're as popular as ever, %s. You must be tired. Will you be all right? You only just returned from Lifthrasir.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'm all right, Chloris. Let's say goodbye here.

lines.speaker: 클로리스
lines.text: If you say you're all right, I won't worry.

lines.speaker: 제피로스
lines.text: Take care, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Goodbye, both of you. I'll see you again.

steps.name: Beyond the Suspicious Door
steps.objective:
1. Talk to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」, then follow [Arche] to where 「Pneuma」 connects to another place.
2. Talk to Iris in 「Oracle Chamber」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] at your destination.

lines.text: (Following Aerura, the adventurer returns to Pneuma. The once-lively spirits are moving unusually slowly.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Something's wrong...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aerura? You were so lively a moment ago... What's going on?
(Aerura, who brought the adventurer here from outside, also slows down upon entering Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, you're here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you all right, Arche?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm all right, but something's happened to the spirits. Don't worry too much, though. They've only slowed down a little.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it something to do with Chronos and Kairos?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: No, it isn't. They'll be back to normal soon.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, what's happened? Please tell me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's not really a secret... A door suddenly appeared in Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A door?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I've never seen anything like it since coming to Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Do you know where it leads?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I can't leave Pneuma, so several spirits volunteered to go. But when they reached the door, none could enter.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: A place even Chronos and Kairos can't approach... If it bars even Pneuma's spirits, that means they haven't been given permission.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Permission...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A being above the spirits...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (A god...?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I thought you and Iris should know, %s, so I contacted you. I'm keeping watch, and I'll tell you immediately if I notice anything suspicious.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Adventurer?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, sorry, Arche... Could you show me where the door is?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: The door? Follow me.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Here. It looks like an ordinary path, but there's an invisible wall across it.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hmm...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I can't really tell... Huh?
(As %s takes a step forward, Pneuma's perpetually bright scenery begins to blur.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, this is... Ar...che?
(Arche fades away without a trace, as though erased. A voice that seems faintly familiar echoes from somewhere.)
「I shall permit you to enter. But you are bound to that child. Obtain her permission as well.」
「Then you shall arrive in ▒▒▒▒, where the light has died.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
「Mortal. Unless you hurry, the soul of Arche, so dear to Gaia, will be consumed here in my hand...」
(The moment the voice falls silent, the darkness invading Pneuma swallows %s whole.)
(The deep darkness soon lifts, returning %s to warm light. But the scene before them is no longer Pneuma.)
(Iris looks at %s in startled confusion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, that wound from before... Are you all right now?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm all right. I was going to meet with you and tell you when I had the chance.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: But how did you get here? No one should be able to enter right now...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, right. There's no time for this. Iris, let me go there. Pneuma is in danger.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Calm down. What do you mean?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sorry... Here's what happened.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I tell Iris about Arche's message and my visit to Pneuma.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Th-that's...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: No. You went to Pneuma to meet Gaia, but that other place is somewhere humans must never go. We have no allies there.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I've never been there myself, but I can feel it. The light is gone. It's desolate, cold, and terribly lonely.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Gods once dwelled there. Your human body couldn't withstand it for long, %s. And my power cannot reach you there.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'll find some way to help Pneuma. Gaia's touch remains there. There must be something I can do.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: So please...
(Iris stops short, surprised as %s takes her hand.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That god tried to erase Arche right in front of me. I have to go. Iris, help me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche's soul... Gaia cares so much for her...
(Iris sighs as though she can object no longer. She quietly releases %s's hand and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Honestly, %s... You're every bit as stubborn as I am. Is this how Muwen and Zoe felt when they tried to stop me? Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris...?

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: I'm only saying that because I'm frustrated. I'm allowing it because it's Arche.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: There won't be a next time. I'll tie you down somewhere by force if I have to.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you, Iris.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: Listen carefully.

lines.speaker: 이리스
lines.text: That place is called Elysia...
(The moment Iris speaks the name Elysia, dense shadows begin to gather around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what is this?
「Iris.」
(The voice of the being that brought the shadows to Pneuma echoes from within them.)
「You, a God of the Astral Realm, have spoken Elysia's name. Then I shall take your mortal.」
(The thick shadows close in around %s. Ominous, incomprehensible chants, somehow familiar, begin tormenting %s's ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Aaaah...
「The black moon shall seize you.」
「The black moon shall carry you away.」
「The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away.」
「The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away.」
「The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away. The black moon shall seize you. The black moon shall carry you away.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop it. Stop...
「Welcome, mortal.」

steps.name: A Place Deprived of Light
steps.objective: Defeat [Precise Anzu] and [Once-Diligent Lessercula] in 「Elysia」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] on the 「Road to Elysia」.

lines.text: (After an unknowable stretch of agony, the sounds tormenting %s fade, and the darkness around them vanishes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Iris? Iris... Iris? Where are you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait, this place...
(A strange sea beneath an enormous moon, twisted trees floating above the water, and a cliff with no bottom in sight. An utterly alien world fills the adventurer's vision.)
Mind yourself. Fall down there, and you'll never climb back up.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? Right. Uh...
(As the adventurer regains their senses and steps back, a powerfully built man in armor slowly approaches.)
(With his long red hair, beard, and armor, the elderly man resembles a blazing sun. His expression is unreadable.)
I was told you would be brought here, but I didn't think you would really come, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You know me?
Of course. First, allow me to apologize for my descendants' foolishness. What happened in the Kingdom of Jude makes my blood boil...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: The Kingdom of Jude...? Wait. Then you're...
I am Irfan of the Agni clan.
(As Irfan introduces himself, a flaming Gigant Pole appears beside him, then vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Aslan is the thirty-fifth head. I was the sixth. That should tell you how much time has passed. There can't be anyone left who remembers me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Still, it's a pleasure. It's been a long time since I saw one of the living.
(Irfan extends his hand.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You still look rather lost. You're leaving my hand hanging here. Would you shake it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, I'm sorry.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Thank you. I'm glad you're a polite young person.
(Irfan shakes hands vigorously, looking pleased.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irfan, I have a question. Where are we? And you just said "one of the living"...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: This is Elysia...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It was a place where the ancient gods came to rest. Those gods loved Etoile, and while they stayed here, this place shone with their light.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: But as they departed or vanished, Elysia lost its light as well. As you can see, only the cold remains.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What do you think of Elysia as it is now...?
(Irfan gazes thoughtfully at the water spilling over the precipice.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Ah, I nearly forgot one of your questions.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Elysia places no restrictions on visits from gods. But other beings may come here after death. Like me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I came here after I died, in answer to a summons. I had reached the end of my life and closed my eyes surrounded by family. Someone offered a hand to guide me. I took it, and found myself here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Don't you know a girl in much the same situation? Arche, in Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, Arche!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I know my master used that girl as bait to summon you. There is something you are wanted for.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Whatever it is, this isn't the way to ask.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: My master may do as they please. A god has that right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't say something so absurd. Even a god has no right to do this!!

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand how you feel. But I serve my master. No amount of complaining to me will change that.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: And I will overlook your insults this once. If you persist...
(Irfan reaches out. The Gigant Pole that vanished behind him appears in his hand, and hidden flames burst forth to circle him.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even if you belong to Seres, Gaia, and the new God of the Astral Realm, I will reduce you to ash.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Ugh... What an overwhelming presence...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The choice is yours.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Overcome the trials as my master wishes, or be buried beneath them and disappear.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Trials... Just like Barbatos...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, enough idle chatter.
(The Gigant Pole in Irfan's hand turns to flame and vanishes.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: First, I want to see your strength. Travel through Elysia, face the beings from other worlds, and return.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It is good for Elysia to meet Etoile again. Less so for beings from other worlds to arrive as well.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right. Then when I return, you'll tell me what I need to do?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Yes. I swear it in the names of Agni, the Sun God, and my master, ▒▒▒.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I still can't hear that name. Nothing I can do about it.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll deal with them and come back, Irfan. Wait here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Good. Don't take too long.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Someone has entered without an invitation from ▒▒▒. Shall I watch for a while?

steps.name: The Will of a God
steps.objective: Defeat [Di-Urta] and [Manun, Guide of Death] in 「Elysia」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Well done.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Now tell me what I need to do.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You're impatient. I was just about to tell you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Even lesser gods from other worlds must have been difficult opponents...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The lord of Elysia, ▒▒▒, opened the gates personally and summoned them here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: They may have been gods in their own worlds, but the moment they crossed the threshold, they became subject to my master's will.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why do I have to fight them?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: That is their affair. They accepted the bargain because it served their purposes. It is beyond the understanding of mortals like you and me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Accept it as a god's will.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now that you've entered, do not defy my master. Overcoming the trials is the only thing you can do here.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Act on any foolish notions, and your worst fears will come to pass.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Calling it a god's will doesn't change the fact that you're threatening me.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Heh heh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll live up to those expectations. You said that's all I can do anyway.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You... have more spirit than is good for you.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Come. Follow me.

steps.name: The First Trial
steps.objective: Defeat [Anshara] in 「Trial of the Black Moon」 and obtain a <Fragment of the Joy of Trials>. Then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.text: (In one corner of Elysia, a moon-shaped stone embedded in a large rock shines brightly in the distance.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The Trial of the Black Moon is on the left. The Trial of the Earth is on the right. Enter the Trial of the Black Moon first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How do I enter?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Stand before the moon-shaped stone and extend your hand. Elysia's power will guide you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Understood.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Nothing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (There's no point arguing with someone who won't listen to reason.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Once again, the Trial of the Black Moon comes first.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait here. I'll finish it and be right back.
(Irfan watches %s closely as they walk past him.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: An interesting one. To believe all gods are alike...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So those are our uninvited guests. Of all things, those stinking beasts...
(The moment %s touches the moon-shaped stone, shadows rise from nowhere and guide them to a new place.)
(In contrast to the warmth beneath their feet at the edge of the land, the endless cosmos behind them feels colder than anywhere else.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is where the trial begins... Everything feels so wrong. But those are...
(Two figures wait in the distance, as though expecting the trial's challenger. One waves in friendly greeting.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Welcome, %s. What do you think of the trial ▒▒▒ made for you?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Kazno, I don't like being inside someone else's trial either. But if we're going to finish what we started, we don't have a choice.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You spoke last time. This time, I'll talk.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: All right.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: But... what do you mean, last time?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You don't seem to remember. Oh well. For ▒▒▒ to have done this to you, they must be furious.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wait...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't know when this happened, but one thing's certain. I'm here because of that god... Whether I remember it or not, that hasn't changed.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You've changed quite a bit... What would you have been like if you'd shared our fate? I suddenly find myself wondering.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Enough.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I was just about to stop.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what did you want to tell me?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Ouroboros was born from a misinterpretation of Iris's will.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It intends to return the world to nothingness. And that is by no means unrelated to what the witches and demons are doing.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's why we're searching for traces of Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would Agasuras search for Ouroboros?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We don't want this world to disappear either. There are things we can only do while it still exists.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It may seem contradictory, but that's our nature. You know what we are. Sinners.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: So we found our own ways to act for Iris's sake.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We made a deal with Shynic, one of the Champions who knew of traces left by Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We secured her cooperation by promising to free her from her curse, staking my life and Kazno's on it. Then we pursued the serpent shadow, an avatar of Ouroboros.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You already know what happened with the serpent shadow.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We tried to seal the pact to lift Shynic's curse, but she refused. She said sinners were no fun, and she never wanted anything to do with us again.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's what she said, anyway. I think it was because everyone responsible for what happened to her was gone.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: The pact itself should hold, but if someone tampers with Perse's power, Shynic could lose control.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Shynic will be all right.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Well, Shynic can look after herself. Since then, tracking Ouroboros has become easier. We've even found bait to draw it out.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: We're waiting for the moment Ouroboros shows itself to take the bait. The problem is that the bait keeps running away. Hehe.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this bait?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: I can't tell you that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then can you answer this? How did you get into Elysia?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Through Kazno's will and mine, you might say. Hehe. I hope that answers your question.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Let's go. We have work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Are you going to find that bait?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Let's leave it at that.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, get these trials over with quickly. Then we can meet again later.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: That's goodbye for today.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: We'll be going...
(Their words finished, Jeril and Kazno run into the deepening darkness, toward an unknown destination.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So that's what those two are after... Sigh. If Ouroboros is caught, at least Iris will have one less thing to worry about.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh, there's no time to stand around.
(The darkness ahead swells, as though about to devour everything within the trial.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A trial made for me... Sigh. I don't understand. Let's just go.
(After defeating the approaching beings from other worlds one after another, %s reaches a dead end. An enormous black figure waits ahead, as if expecting them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...
(Spotting %s, the black figure steps forward and slams its weapon into the ground.)
Boom!
(A moment later, the world begins shaking as though struck by an earthquake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A rabbit?
(It walks like a human and is far too large for an ordinary rabbit. Golden gauntlets grip an enormous hammer. The creature regards the adventurer with an otherworldly air.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You're a rabbit, but you don't like being called one?
(The black rabbit nods.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ansha...? Anshara?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's your name? And that was your greeting?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Wait... It hasn't said a word... Why does it feel like I'm hearing a voice?)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So what do you want here?
(Anshara frowns and raises its two-handed hammer toward %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What? How dare I?
(Anshara nods silently.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A god from another world? You made a contract with this place's ruler, and though this isn't the form you wanted, you're going to crush me as the contract requires?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: And you're angry that I dare speak to a god this way? Well, I can't help that.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have things I need to do. Huh?
(At that moment, a powerful wave of energy grazes %s's face.)
(A cut opens across %s's cheek, and blood begins to flow.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: This is only the beginning?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I didn't expect you to declare war quite like that, but so be it. I'll finish this trial, whatever it takes.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Isn't this what you wanted, Anshara?
(The instant their eyes meet, Anshara charges forward at tremendous speed, hammer raised.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then let's do this. At least the god behind me is more trustworthy than you.
(Anshara takes %s's blow head-on and falls.)
(It rises once more, but its gauntlets shatter, and the golden hammer slips from its grip.)
(Then it slumps to the ground, its light slowly fading as its strength drains away.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You really can't stand losing to a human you looked down on... Making all that noise even as you fall...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah... I'm exhausted...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I'm dizzy...)
(The ominous shadows encroaching on the area swallow what was Anshara only moments ago.)
(The voice of the trial's creator drifts from between the shadows.)
「Mortal. Even a lesser god from another world must have been no easy opponent.」
「Thanks to you, Anshara's power now belongs to Elysia. You have my gratitude.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You used a god from another world to feed this place...
「Are you curious?」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: No. I don't want to hear it. I'll finish the next trial. Then restore Arche and Pneuma.
「How confident.」
「I had no intention of touching Pneuma at first. But I grew curious about your reaction. You are a more entertaining mortal than I expected.」

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's been a while since anyone called me entertaining.
「Complete every trial, and I shall return them. Both the girl and Pneuma. Now prove yourself in the next trial, mortal.」
(With that ominous god's final warning, the shadows vanish. A path that seems to lead outside appears between them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A path to the trial... I suppose I have to follow it.

steps.name: The Ruler of Elysia
steps.objective: Meet the being who invited you in 「Nameless Place」, then return to 「Elysia 2」 and turn in the quest to [Irfan].

lines.text: (Irfan opens his eyes, as though sensing something. When the adventurer slowly emerges from behind the moon-shaped stone, he smiles faintly.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You look exhausted. Still, you've returned safely. That's what matters.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I finished it, but...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand your anger. I know my words only make it worse. Even so, quietly proceed to the next trial...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You met the beasts waiting inside, didn't you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Beasts? I don't know who you mean. I did meet a rabbit pretending to be a god...
(Flames from Irfan's Gigant Pole begin circling %s's feet.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Give me a proper answer.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Two Agasuras.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What is your connection to them, and what did you discuss?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: We run into each other from time to time. They said they were looking for something.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I see.
(Irfan nods, and the flames beneath %s's feet vanish without a trace.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: If those uninvited beasts are searching for something, it must be important. They know that too, I'm sure.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: For beings born of the world's contradictions to take action...
(As Irfan strokes his beard, Elysia suddenly begins to shake.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what's happening?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It seems we have another uninvited guest besides those beasts.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I thought beings who weren't invited couldn't enter Elysia?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: So did I. Ha ha. Aren't you curious about what's happening here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Then visit the empty space in one corner of Elysia. You'll soon discover how your connections intertwine.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What do you mean...?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Just go.
(Irfan silently watches %s walk away, looking thoroughly displeased.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: My lord, ▒▒▒...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You've changed your mind... What will you do next?
(The moment %s steps onto a path discovered while exploring Elysia, thick darkness spreads around them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (As though it were waiting for me... What should I do? This has to be...)
(While %s pauses to assess the situation, the darkness recedes slightly, revealing a pair of bare feet.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Who are you?
(The darkness gradually disperses, revealing the figure concealed within it.)
(At the heart of this lightless world, a woman shines like a moon harboring darkness. She studies %s's face without expression.)
You wish to know my name?
Mortal...
If you are so eager, I shall tell you.
(The woman extends a hand and caresses %s's frozen face.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I-I can't move... This pressure... Huh?)
(At that instant, a name flows into %s's mind.)
Mortal. Speak the name that echoes within your mind.
I asked you who I am. The mistress of the black moon, of death, and of those who await the night.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He...
Speak...!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He...cate...
(When the name Hecate leaves %s's lips, the woman smiles in satisfaction. Then she seizes the mere mortal by the throat and hurls them away.)
Thud.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: No wonder your attitude angered Anshara.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Now rise, mortal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh... uh...
(Hecate approaches %s as they struggle to rise and offers a hand. But the mortal, so foolish in her eyes, bats it aside.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't... need your hand...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I understand your wishes. Then I shall change my judgment as well.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: O world of mine...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (This is...)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: O mist of death rising from the black moon that blankets the earth.
(The black shadows that had vanished rise around Hecate once more.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Here is a soul for the primordial darkness to consume. Seize it and carry it away... in my name, Hecate...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I-I have to escape. I can't...)
(The shadows become serpents, slithering toward %s and tightening around their throat.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't die here...)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I can't die...)
(Like the primordial cosmos before even this lightless world existed, %s's small world sinks into profound darkness.)
Snap out of it!!
(Someone shouts at %s, helpless in the swamp of darkness.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...Who?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: How did you get...?
(The thick darkness parts slightly, revealing Hilda gripping Hecate's wrist.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: You're awake. Hurry, run!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: My feet won't move...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I didn't expect you to come all the way here, Hilda.
(Hecate frowns at Hilda's hand on her wrist.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If you're going to play games, know when to stop, Hecate.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You barge into my domain and dare address its mistress so carelessly...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Hilda's moving as if nothing's wrong. I still can't move my feet...)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Release my hand. I will not tell you twice.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You know as well as I do that this is a foolish act of stubborn defiance.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: I want to live. Let this person go.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Coming here must have taken resolve. And all for such a paltry reason...
(Hecate shakes off Hilda's hand and steps back.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hilda, this is my world. Elysia. What do you think you can accomplish here?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: That child is loved by Gaia and Seres. And it is my will that the mortal she cherishes should die here.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You should know that even you, a witch, can die in this place...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I have to live. I have to get out of here...)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: A god who sees only half the picture... You're the one who shaped my fate, just like those who pursue the night. But...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Do you truly think I do not know?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: If Ouroboros appears, the world you desire will...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ouroboros...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Just let this person go. I'll handle the rest...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You propose a bargain? That is not how bargains are made. First...
(Hecate gazes silently at one spot. A path concealed by darkness appears, and a boy emerges from it.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Well, this is awkward... I didn't expect to run into the Goddess of the Black Moon.
(Jeril scratches his cheek and slowly steps forward.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why are you coming out of there, Jeril...?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: %s, did you forget what I said earlier? We have our own work to do.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Work? What on earth are you trying to do...?
(As though nothing is amiss, Jeril walks past Hecate to %s's side and examines their condition.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: It's been a while since I saw our adventurer too terrified to move. Ha ha. Even if I wanted to save you, this would be tricky.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Hilda, it's been a while. No need to be afraid. I'll take you away soon, so just wait.
(At that moment, black vines burst from beneath Hecate's feet and hurtle toward Jeril.)
(But a beast's roar rings out, stopping the advancing vines. They wither and retreat into the shadows.)

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Goddess of the Black Moon, aren't you underestimating me?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I have nothing to say to a beast.

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: You were trapped and helpless when the world was in danger... You're as arrogant and foolish as Lethe, Goddess. How long will you keep this up?

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Stay out of my way.

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Ah... I'm dizzy...
(Hilda's legs give way as she watches, and she sinks to the ground.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Hilda, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: S-step back a little. I'm... dizzy...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: So that's it...
(Hecate smiles, as though Hilda's distress has told her something.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I see. Now I understand why you say you want to live.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: %s, allow me to tell you a truth. You and Hilda are...

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Stop!!
(As Hilda shouts, the space around them begins to tremble.)

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Hecate, I said stop!!

lines.speaker: 제릴
lines.text: Wait, Hilda. If you do this now...
(A spear of green light appears in Hilda's hand and flies toward Hecate's throat.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You exist through the black moon's power. How far do you intend to defy me?!

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Swallow them all.
(At Hecate's furious command, shadows flood the world again, as though erasing everyone who stood there moments before.)
(The shadows gradually recede, restoring Elysia to the way it looked upon the adventurer's arrival.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Wh-what...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Everyone's gone...
(Hilda and Jeril, who were arguing with Hecate only moments ago, are nowhere to be seen.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Where did they go? What did Hecate do...? Oh, I can move again...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Huh?
(Irfan appears, though there is no telling when he left his post near the trial's gate.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate has withdrawn... for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (For now?)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You look surprised. Yes, for now.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I cannot know Lady Hecate's intentions, but she has chosen to give you another chance...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: A chance?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Attempt the remaining trial. The Trial of the Earth still awaits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: She appeared out of nowhere and tried to kill me... and now she's giving me another chance?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Such opportunities are rare. You should be grateful.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (Am I supposed to accept this as some kind of opportunity...? Beings like Barbatos, Lethe, and Hecate think so differently from us.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Rest here a while. When you're ready, return to the trial gates.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It takes time to recover after being crushed beneath a god's power.
(Having delivered his message, Irfan returns to the trial entrances.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He said that as though he'd experienced it himself.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I suppose I have no choice. I don't know this place, so I can only do as I'm told...

steps.name: The Second Trial
steps.objective: Defeat [Kishara] in 「Trial of the Earth」 and obtain a <Fragment of the Sorrow of Trials>. Then turn in the quest to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」.

lines.text: (Irfan, lost in thought with his eyes closed, opens them at %s's approach.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I've rested, as you suggested.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Perhaps it's the gods' blessings, but you seem to recover quickly in Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I do feel lighter, but I don't think that's why...)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, look to the right.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Just as with the Trial of the Black Moon, stand before the moon-shaped stone, approach it, and extend your hand.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: It will guide you into the trial.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll overcome this one too, and return.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Confident as ever. Off you go, then.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Um... Irfan.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What is it?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Once I've completed every trial, will my business in Elysia be finished?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Hmm.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: They aren't my trials, so I can't promise. Still, Lady Hecate will keep her word.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Though she could change her mind along the way...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So she's just fickle.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Heh heh. I've never met anyone who speaks of gods like you do. Despite all my warnings...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I was talking to myself. Pretend you didn't hear. I'll be going now.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: The trial will hardly be enjoyable, but I wish you luck nonetheless.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's encouragement I could have done without.)
(The moment the adventurer touches the moon-shaped stone, shadows rise from nowhere and carry them to another new place.)
(A human face carved into an enormous boulder gazes down from a desolate hill. Sharp thorn bushes fill the spaces between the slopes.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's suffocating...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Keep your wits about you, %s. This is no ordinary place... And what's wrong with this path?
(Sharp plant stems lie across a path formed from jagged stone fragments.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: So this is what you prepared for a trial...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, I just met that stone face's eyes. Are you listening? Sigh. Then I'll say one thing.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You said you'd keep your promise. I'll trust you on that. Now...
(Though the trial was unwanted, the adventurer accepts it and spends a long time seeking a way through, eventually reaching a dead end.)
(A torch burns in the distance, as red as Agni's flames.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What am I supposed to do here?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's...
(Taking another step, the adventurer notices a statue of a woman at the far end.)
(Three women who seem to weep blood share a single body, bearing a torch, a key, and a dagger. The sight evokes something beyond mere revulsion.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What is this...?
(As the adventurer approaches, the statue rattles as though shaking in the wind.)
(The statue's eyes widen and its tightly closed mouth opens. The sound pouring forth reaches %s's ears and begins tearing through their mind.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Uhhhh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ugh, stop... Wait, what? What are you saying?
(As when facing Anshara, the statue's message spreads through %s's mind as though perfectly comprehensible.)
「You've come to kill me too.」
「Don't kill Kishara.」
「Do you know how hard it is to return from death?!」
(Each time the statue calling itself Kishara speaks, inexplicable pain and terror wash over %s.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I need to cover my ears. Anything I can use... Oh, this...)
(Surprised to find an orange ribbon in their pocket, the adventurer quickly cuts it up and plugs their ears.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...That's a little better. Phew...
(Kishara continues pouring out incomprehensible words as it slowly begins to move.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「I don't want to die again.」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「Can Hecate save Kishara?」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「Such arrogance, to stand before a god and not kneel.」
(Speaking as though several distinct personalities are quarreling, Kishara suddenly raises its key, torch, and dagger.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Don't tell me...
(The separate Kisharas seem to have chosen the same target. All cry out together.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『We will kill you here and now!!』
(A tremendous impact sends fragments flying from Kishara's body and embedding themselves in the ground.)
Boom!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hah... hah...
(Cracks spread across the statue's heads. It loses its balance and topples to the ground.)
(As cracks spread through the fallen statue, Kishara, silent until now, begins speaking again.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「We had a chance to live again...」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「We could never have lived in this body.」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「Hecate only used Kishara.」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『It's over anyway.』

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I have nothing against you. But I have to finish this trial.

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「We already knew how a fleeing god would end...」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「There was no place left to return to.」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 「And the things someone once sang of were gone...」

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『We should never have taken Hecate's hand. What imprisoned Hecate... what Hecate imprisoned...』

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Graaagh...』
(Pouring out cryptic words and a grotesque groan, Kishara hauls its fallen body upright once more.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『We, Kishara, cannot fall like this. Die!!』
(Before Kishara's attack can land, %s strikes through a crack in its broken body.)

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Hecate, you said all we had to do was take the soul that awoke after being buried in ages of time...』

lines.speaker: 키샤라
lines.text: 『Gaaaah... Gaaaaagh!!』
(With a hideous scream, Kishara's mouths close, and more cracks spread through the damaged statue.)
(Then, with a thunderous crash, the statue that was Kishara crumbles to dust and scatters through the trial's space.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's getting darker. I suppose she's about to appear... Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate, the trials are over. Come out and keep your promise!!
(As the shadows rising within the trial stain everything black, Hecate slowly steps out from somewhere.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You succeeded again. Kishara's power, too, will have nourished Elysia.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I had nowhere else to put it, so I placed it in a statue of myself. That seems to have held Kishara back.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It clung to such misplaced hope.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I commend you for overcoming the trials. Well done, mortal.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I don't want your praise. Release Arche, Hilda, and Pneuma at once.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: I truly dislike you, human, whom those children cherish.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You should know a god's word is never given lightly. Very well. I shall return them.
(At Hecate's words, the surrounding shadows withdraw, revealing Hilda lying beneath them.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda!!
(Hecate sneers as %s rushes to Hilda and helps her up.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You have entertained me, mortal. Take Hilda and leave.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The moment Hilda awakens, you will have to choose. Will you destroy her soul and take it for yourself? Or will your own soul crumble, leaving her to kill you?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: ...What do you mean?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Neither you nor Hilda wished it, but your souls were born into that fate. All I can do is guide your soul, which the old man tampered with, toward death.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That's impossible. I would never do that. I am me...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Such impossible things happen even to gods like me. There is nothing strange about their happening to you, %s. Your soul already belongs to more than you alone.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You know that, don't you?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Across the branching paths of time, you have appeared in other forms, and you have died.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: There is a limit to how much Iris can do to alter your curse. Perhaps accepting it and becoming a sinner would not be so bad.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Struggle against death all you like; the outcome is the same, mortal. The only small difference is who kills you.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Have not even the gods bound to Etoile died...?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehe. Don't be afraid. There is still so much amusement to come.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Watch what the children who became witches through my power, who pursue the night, will do, mortal. To speak of it like this... I owe the sleeping Gaia an apology.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate!!
(Hecate frowns, displeased to hear her name shouted.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Today is the last time I will tolerate your insolence. Until we meet again, mortal... do try to stay alive.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: And Iris as well...
(With those parting words, Hecate vanishes into the dense shadows. A moment later, the darkness filling the space rapidly dissipates.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate, wait!!

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Damn it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why would that happen to me...?

lines.speaker: 힐다
lines.text: Uh... uhh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Are you awake?
(Unable to open her eyes, Hilda murmurs %s's name, then loses consciousness again.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda? Stay with me. Stay...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Kazno? Oh, right. Jeril...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Don't worry about Jeril. Go check on the spirit world at once. I'll take this witch...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Stop. I know Hilda is the bait to draw out Ouroboros. That's why you're taking her, isn't it?

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: I have no intention of doing that now. If we get her to Iris, this witch can survive.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then that's all the more reason for me to take her.

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: %s!! Get hold of yourself!! Listen to me right now!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: For your own sake, and for Iris's, listen to me!!

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Once we're outside, the moment Hilda opens her eyes and sees you, one of you will die. So...

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Unless you want to bring about the worst with your own hands, leave her to me for now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: All right...
(Kazno studies %s's resigned expression, then lifts Hilda up.)

lines.speaker: 카즈노
lines.text: Consult Iris later about what to do with this witch. And for now, I won't harm Hilda...
(The instant Kazno takes Hilda's weight, he vanishes from the spot.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: He's gone... How...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hilda's back, at least, but still... Is Pneuma all right? Is Arche...?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'd better ask Irfan...

steps.name: Overcoming the Trials
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] in 「Elysia 2」, then turn in the quest to [Irfan] on the 「Road to Elysia」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Well done. I thought Lady Hecate's trials unusually harsh this time. Judging by your expression, I was right...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Irfan, what about Pneuma...?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate has restored it. You needn't worry.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You really don't trust her. Most gods are much like Lady Hecate, you know.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Perhaps it's because the gods you serve haven't shown you their imposing side...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Sigh. Never mind. Follow me. Back to where we first met.

steps.name: A Restless Soul
steps.objective: Talk to [Irfan] on the 「Road to Elysia」, then turn in the quest to [Arche] in 「Pneuma」.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: You may now come and go freely in Elysia.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Lady Hecate has granted you passage. Next time, follow the path from Pneuma.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: She also said she would leave the trials in place. If you wish to grow stronger, she thought repeating them might do you good.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: After I barely managed to finish them, she wants me to do them again...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Since you struggle to accept a god's will, she has graciously left the choice to you.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Yes. How gracious...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Now, go back. Once you've checked on Pneuma, return to Iris and let her know you're safe.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Off you go.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I am going... Why does it feel like he's hurrying me along...?)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Oh, next time, bring me some desert sand.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: You sound very sure I'll be back...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Someday, you'll need to hear about my past. Even if you don't, Lady Hecate looks forward to seeing you again.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Follow that circle of light, and you'll reach Pneuma.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I'll be going. See you again, Irfan.
(Once %s has disappeared, Hecate approaches Irfan, who remains at his post.)

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Are you well, Lady Hecate?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You, once a mortal, ask after a god's well-being? Hmph... Well enough, it seems.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Forgive me...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: If I am not, then I am not. If I am, one might say I am. In my present circumstances, that is all I can say.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: I understand. But weren't you planning to descend?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: The Agasuras have left, and Elysia holds only you and me. Yet another guest is coming... One I did not invite, of course...

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: A black butterfly...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: He's arrived.
(A black butterfly flutters in from somewhere, loses its light, and falls to the ground. A man slowly approaches and crushes it underfoot.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Perhaps it's been too long, but this place feels terribly unfamiliar. Ah...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: It has been a while, Mistress of the Black Moon. I didn't expect you to come out and greet me personally.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You found the way here. Have you regained some of what you lost?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Ha ha. Not yet.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You have survived a long time in that demon's shell. Why come to Elysia? Why not keep wallowing with Pandemonium's filthy devils and demons?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: And why didn't the Goddess of the Black Moon vanish along with the other gods? You chose to spend all that time imprisoned instead, didn't you?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: A filthy demon speaks far too freely.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: We're both in the business of dirty work...
(Barbatos raises his weapon toward Hecate. A boy who followed him in startles at the scene and hurriedly hides behind Irfan.)

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Wh-what? The grand duke told me to come here, then the moment he sees her, he makes it obvious they hate each other.

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Is she the one...?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Did the grand duke say he'd introduce you to Lady Hecate?

lines.speaker: 노네임
