lines.text: No. He told me to follow him if I didn't want to die. Hey, old man. Who is that woman?

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: What an ill-mannered child.

lines.speaker: 이르판
lines.text: Just watch. This is no place for people like us to intervene...

lines.speaker: 노네임
lines.text: Really?
(Hecate quietly pushes Barbatos's greatsword aside with a fingertip.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Grand Duke, I have no reason to fight you.

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Once you awoke and involved yourself in the world, surely you were prepared to die?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Is that how you see it, Grand Duke? It makes little difference to me.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: So, Grand Duke...

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: How many gods have you cut down?

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Hehe. Who can say? Ask me something else. I'll answer just one question.
(Barbatos puts away his greatsword and adjusts his glasses.)

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Shall I?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: You had ample time to cut down Gaia in the Sanctuary. Yet you did not.
(A deep shadow falls across Barbatos's face as he listens.)

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: Would killing you here serve as an answer to that question?

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Hehe. You needn't answer if you don't wish to, Grand Duke. I only wanted to see your reaction.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: Now, I have a proposal for you...

lines.speaker: 바르바토스
lines.text: I'll hear it, then decide.

lines.speaker: 헤카테
lines.text: It should suit the tastes of one who crawled up from the abyss of despair. Let us begin.
(An anxious-looking Arche spots %s and hurries over.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Are you all right?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche, are you all right?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I-I think so. Pneuma and the spirits are back to normal... I'm all...
(Arche's legs give way and she sinks to the ground. Alarmed, the adventurer quickly helps her up, but she cannot stop trembling.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche... You're not all right at all...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'm scared.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I never thought I'd feel this way again after coming to Pneuma...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's like that time.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: That time...?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: When my soul failed to merge and broke away, I felt terror. I hadn't felt such fear even when I was reborn...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Pneuma is back to normal, as though nothing happened... But just knowing a door to Elysia has opened...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I... I keep remembering things I never wanted to think about. It hurts...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I shouldn't be like this. Not when Gaia needs me...
(Several Atmos approach and circle Arche, as though trying to soothe her distress.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Thank you, everyone...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Feeling a little calmer?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Yes... A little. I'm sorry, %s. After all you've done for Pneuma, you shouldn't have to see me like this...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right, Arche. Get some rest.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I see...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll go see Iris, then. Huh, Arche?
(Arche takes %s's hand.)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: You mustn't go now.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Why not?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Before you returned, %s, Iris sent me a message through the spirits.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: What did she say?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: That Hilda, the woman you rescued, is all right. And that you mustn't visit her until the time is right, %s.

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I think...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It's because your souls have similar colors...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Then I suppose there's no helping it...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (What should I do now...? Is waiting my only option...?)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: %s, please don't worry too much.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: I'll try. But, Arche...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: What?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Hecate only said we were fated to harm each other's souls. What do you mean, our souls are similar?

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Did you already know what happens when similar souls meet?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Well...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Is it a secret?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: It isn't a secret. But even if I told you, you wouldn't be able to hear it properly, %s.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Oh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (That's right. No matter how often someone told me, I couldn't hear it without a god's permission...)

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Iris only learned of it now, when the Goddess of the Black Moon spoke... I'm sorry I can't help...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: It's all right. I'll wait until Iris calls me.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Sigh...

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Arche... May I rest in Pneuma for a while before I go?

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: Of course. Stay as long as you like.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Ever since the witches appeared, my mind's been in such turmoil...

lines.speaker: 아르케
lines.text: I'll lend you Aerura.

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: Thank you...
(Several Aerura drifting through Pneuma's sky float toward %s, scattering feathers and flower petals.)

lines.speaker: %s
lines.text: (I thought finding Iris and helping her was what I had to do... But there's more to it than that...)
(The moment the adventurer leans against an Aerura that has approached as though to offer comfort, the anxiety from moments before melts away.)
(And so they sink into a deep sleep. So deep that they almost never want to wake.)
